intro.title: Role-Based Route Protection
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a React application that protects certain routes based on a user's role, such as 'admin' or 'user'. You will learn how to implement role-based route protection using React Router and conditional rendering. The core programming concept involves checking a user's role stored in state and conditionally allowing or redirecting access to specific routes. You will work with React components, state management, and route configuration to create a secure navigation experience. By the end, you'll have a functional app where only authorized users can access protected pages based on their assigned roles.
intro.usecase: Role-based route protection is essential in applications with multiple user types, such as admin dashboards, enterprise SaaS platforms, and banking apps. For example, an admin dashboard might show analytics and user management pages only to administrators, while hiding them from regular customers. A healthcare portal could restrict patient records to doctors and nurses, preventing access by billing staff. Implementing this ensures data security, regulatory compliance, and a tailored user experience by controlling navigation and content based on permissions.
